servesPizza.name: Willmott's Ghost
servesPizza.note: An all-day Italian restaurant on the ground floor of Amazon's Spheres; Roman-style pizza al taglio dominates its lunch menu alongside starters, salads, and secondi like lemon ricotta lasagna.

servesPizza.name: Cinque Terre Ristorante
servesPizza.note: An Italian ristorante in Amazon's Doppler building; its stone-oven Neapolitan pizzas (margherita, calabrese, bianca) are served alongside pastas and entrees.

servesPizza.name: Big Time Brewery & Alehouse
servesPizza.note: Seattle's original brewpub, pouring its own beer since 1988; its kitchen menu includes 8-inch and 16-inch pizzas (cheese, pepperoni, Hawaiian, BBQ chicken, and more) alongside sandwiches and burgers.

servesPizza.name: Fiddler's Inn Pub & Pizza
servesPizza.note: A neighborhood pub with a patio and live music; serves 10-inch and 16-inch pub pizzas alongside sandwiches and salads.
